entities.summary: Mark Anthony Essien is a Nigerian entrepreneur, software developer and startup investor. He is the founder and CEO of Hotels.ng, one of the first online hotel booking websites in Nigeria. Before he founded Hotels.ng in 2013, Essien had previously built a file sharing software called Gnumm, followed by a language learning startup called Ingolingo.
